subject: Compact audit manifest & export plan for SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Angela Soto <angela.soto@medicosys.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@medicosys.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ - compact manifest for audit logs and admin activity

Hi Laura,

We're finalizing our SIG/CAIQ submission and the assessor asked for a concise manifest that maps what you can provide for audit logs and admin activity evidence. To keep the review small, can you provide a single-page "compact manifest" that answers:

- Which event classes you capture (e.g., console/admin actions, API request/response, token/key changes, model loads/access)
- Per-event retention (days) and earliest available export window
- Export formats you support (JSONL/Parquet/CloudTrail-style) and compression options
- Redaction/PII treatment (what is redacted vs hashed vs omitted)
- Delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, Box, etc.) and typical delivery SLA for an initial snapshot
- Integrity guarantees (checksums, signing) and chain-of-custody notes

If you have a short template or sample export, that would help the assessor verify quickly. Our timeline is tight: we'd like the manifest + one small sample snapshot by EOD next Wednesday (May 26).

Thanks,
Angela Soto
Security & Compliance
MedicoSys

---

(Attachment: requirements_from_assessor.pdf — 1 page summary)

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Soto <angela.soto@medicosys.com>
Cc: compliance@medicosys.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - compact manifest for audit logs and admin activity

Hi Angela — thanks for the clear ask. We'll produce a compact manifest and a small sample snapshot.

High-level plan (summary):
- Deliverables: 1) compact_manifest_template.xlsx (filled), 2) sample_export_20270521.jsonl.gz (<= 5MB gzipped), 3) delivery_spec_checksums.md (checksums + procedure)
- Event classes included: operator_console_actions, operator_api_calls, model_load_and_inference_requests (metadata only), auth_and_token_events, key_management_events, role_changes
- Retention: operator/admin events default 365 days; auth/token events 365; runtime inference logs 90 days (we can extend on request)
- Export formats: gzip-compressed JSONL (default), Parquet for large bulk handoffs, CloudTrail-style JSON optionally (mapping provided)
- Redaction: PII fields are deterministically HMAC-SHA256 hashed; full redaction on request for sensitive fields (we'll include redaction map in manifest)
- Delivery: S3 presigned URL (preferred), SFTP, or encrypted Box share. Initial snapshot SLA 5 business days; weekly incremental deltas after onboarding.
- Integrity: SHA256 checksums for each file; manifest will include file checksums and a signed delivery log.

Questions for you: any fields you need removed entirely (not hashed) or any specific retention windows from your policy team? Also, can you confirm the assessor will accept hashed PII rather than full redaction?

We're attaching a blank compact manifest template and a tiny sample export (generated from test data) for quick validation. Ben, can you add the technical export notes below and confirm snapshot SLA?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: compact_manifest_template.xlsx; sample_export_20270521.jsonl.gz)

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, Angela Soto <angela.soto@medicosys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - compact manifest for audit logs and admin activity

Thanks Laura — adding the technical details here so the assessor has concrete mappings.

What we'll include (fields & formats):
- File layout: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL), gzip compressed. Each line is a single event with envelope fields: event_id, recorded_at (ISO8601 UTC), event_class, actor_id (hashed if PII), target_resource, event_payload (free JSON with sampling for large payloads), request_id, model_version (if inference-related), region

Event classes and sampling/retention:
- operator_console_actions: full detail, retention 365d, available for export back to service inception
- operator_api_calls (API keys, management, config changes): full detail, retention 365d
- auth_and_token_events: include token issuance/refresh/invalidations, retention 365d
- key_management_events (KMS/HSM ops): metadata only (no raw key material), retention 365d
- inference_access_log: metadata-only (prompt hashes + token counts), retention 90d (can be held longer under contract)

Redaction & pseudonymization:
- PII (email, user display name) replaced with HMAC-SHA256(<field> || customer_salt) and we include a redaction_map.json in the manifest that lists fields hashed vs removed.
- For customers requiring stricter controls, we can produce a fully redacted export where sensitive fields are removed entirely — this will be noted in manifest.

Export & delivery mechanics:
- Delivery methods: S3 presigned (preferred) with server-side encryption (AES256) + object-level SHA256 checksums published in delivery_spec_checksums.md; SFTP over SSH on request; secure Box link w/ 2FA for human handoffs.
- Snapshot SLA: initial full snapshot 5 business days after scope approval; weekly incremental deltas (new events only) pushed Monday UTC.
- Integrity: each export file will have a .sha256 file with the hex checksum; we can optionally sign the checksum bundle with our system signing key.

Scope notes & exclusions:
- We do not export low-level GPU kernel traces or raw audio/video payloads — those are out of scope.
- Inference request bodies (prompts) are included only as hashes by default; full plaintext can be included under NDA and with customer request.

I'll prepare the sample_export_20270521.jsonl.gz from our staging bucket and the delivery_spec_checksums.md with SHA256 values.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Infra Engineer, Evidence & Export
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: delivery_spec_checksums.md)

- For the manifest, prefer the single-sheet compact template Laura suggested; include a single-line "acceptance criteria" that the assessor can tick to confirm PII treatment is acceptable.
- Please add a HubSpot activity (deal D-8451) when you deliver the snapshot; Marissa, please coordinate billing/credits if MedicoSys requests extended retention.
